literal_meaning: যেমন দান, তেমন দক্ষিণা (as the donation, so the honorarium)
figurative_meaning_en: The honorarium corresponds to the amount of the donation
similar_in_english: You get what you pay for
As you give, so you receive
example_sentences_in_bangla: পূজার সময় যেমন দান তেমন দক্ষিণা দেওয়া উচিত, অন্যথায় পুরোহিত খুশি হবে না।
তিনি বেশি দান করেছেন, তাই যেমন দান তেমন দক্ষিণা পেয়েছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: During the puja, one should give dakshina according to the donation, otherwise the priest won't be pleased.
He gave a large donation, so he received an honorarium in kind.
note: Refers to Hindu ritual practices where dakshina is given to priests proportional to offerings.
